item.title: Multi-teacher distillation is a token budget
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. TRL’s multi-teacher on-policy distillation example ran 60 steps. Instruction following held 20 percent of the prompts and got 1 to 3 percent of the trained tokens, and it was the only domain that barely moved. Open-MOPD calls this token budget misallocation, and fixing it raised the recoverable headroom from 35.
